free_tier.stated: Developer plan, free and limited to one user: 5k errors, 5GB logs, 5GB application metrics, 5M spans, 50 replays, 1 uptime monitor, 1 cron monitor and 1GB of attachments; a new account starts with 14 days of unlimited volume and then moves to the free plan
free_tier.notes: Counted per event category: errors, spans and replays are event counts, logs and application metrics are GB. The pricing table prints the Developer quantities without a period; the paid plans state the same categories as monthly volume. Events past the quota are not accepted.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: the size limits of the quota documentation are not among the pages quoted

retention.stated: 30 days for every data type on the Developer plan: errors, logs, spans, replays, profiles, crons, uptime, attachments, size analysis and application metrics

egress.terms: not stated: the pricing pages price ingested events only and name no charge for reading data back

interface_detail: SDKs send events over HTTPS to the project; the web API (v0, token authentication, regional hosts us.sentry.io and de.sentry.io) is listed on the Team plan card as an addition ('API & third-party integrations'), so its scope on the Developer plan is unverified; the Developer card lists 'MCP access'
tooling: the Sentry SDKs, the web API and MCP access
chaining: An error sink for jobs on free compute: an SDK inside a scheduled task reports exceptions and one cron check-in to a hosted project with 30 days of history.

limits.value: 5k errors, 5M spans and 50 replays on the Developer plan; events past the quota are not accepted
5GB of logs and 5GB of application metrics on the Developer plan
30 days for every data type on the Developer plan

limits_note: One user, 1 uptime monitor, 1 cron monitor and 10 custom dashboards on the Developer plan.
binding_note: 5k errors is the first category to run out for an application that reports every exception; past it, error events are not accepted until the quota resets.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up form asks for name, organization, email and password behind a reCAPTCHA, or sign-in with Google, GitHub or Azure DevOps; the form has no card field. A new account gets 14 days of unlimited volume and then moves to the free plan, with no forced upgrade.

reliability_note: events and attachments past the quota are not accepted, so monitoring stops until the quota resets
